Hi Connor / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the interview last week — the case study draft looks great. Our comms team would like to publish localized excerpts (DE, FR, SE) alongside an APAC Japanese version for our regional sites. A few asks from our side: 

- Can Redwood provide localized versions of the testimonial or do you prefer we translate and send back for sign-off?

- For Japan, our PR lead (Satoshi) wants to review wording for honorifics and tone.

Attached is the English draft (SkyeHealth-testimonial-draft-en.docx) — please confirm process and a target timeline (we'd like to go live in the week of June 1 if possible).

Best,

Hi Elena — great to hear and glad the draft landed well. High-level plan below — happy to adjust based on what you prefer: 

1) Redwood creates locale-aware drafts for DE/FR/SE and a JP draft; we supply the localized copy for your review (we can do human or machine-assisted translation, you pick).
2) We send a single consent form (one per contact) to be signed via DocuSign. Legal will request a small clause confirming permission to publish translated versions.
3) Satoshi and Priya can request wording changes; we handle up to two rounds of light edits per locale.

Proposed timeline: local drafts by 2026-05-18, consent to you by 2026-05-19, signed by 2026-05-21 — live the week of 2026-06-01. If you need faster, we can prioritize DE/JP first.

I've attached our localization guidelines for reference and CC'd Monica (AM) to coordinate the DocuSign and legal flow.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Forwarding Elena's note. Quick legal and ops notes for the team: 

- Drafted a consent template that includes explicit permission for translated versions and localized excerpts. Attached: consent-form-docusign.docx.
- APAC nuance: Japanese version should avoid overly literal translations of product metrics; prefer localization of examples and polite/formal phrasing (Satoshi to confirm).
- EU nuance: Germany & Sweden will expect precise GDPR notice about where the content is hosted and how long it will be available; include a one-line hosting location statement in the form.

Action items for Aditya: can you quick-redline the consent document and confirm we can use one DocuSign envelope with multiple recipients? Also loop in Laura for marketing approvals if needed.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel

- I moved the GDPR hosting sentence into a separate checkbox to make consent explicit (see consent-form-redlines.pdf).
- DocuSign: we can use a single envelope with four recipients (one per locale contact). That keeps audit trail tidy.
